name: away-mode-indicator
description: Read-only-visible Away mode state chip (chat pane + input row) driven by the AGENTS.md STATUS token.

commands.title: Away Mode: Shift Status Chip Left
Away Mode: Shift Status Chip Right

awayModeIndicator.agentsFile.markdownDescription: Truth-source file holding the `[STATUS: ON|OFF]` token (POSIX, UNC or `~` path).

awayModeIndicator.heading.markdownDescription: Exact heading line the parser anchors on in the truth file. Update it here if the rule is renamed; the `[STATUS: ON|OFF]` token must stay on that line.

awayModeIndicator.position.description: ONE active placement of the chip. Falls back to statusBarLeft (visible in status command) when the chat-area API is unavailable.

awayModeIndicator.style.description: V2 colored dot + word (default) or V5 outlined badge. Identical everywhere, every state.

awayModeIndicator.refreshSeconds.description: Max refresh staleness (seconds); watcher is primary, stat-only poll the guard.

awayModeIndicator.pendingGraceSeconds.description: Window showing the switching color after a token change.

awayModeIndicator.scopeMode.description: global: the token file is the state. window: file seeds, per-window overrides until the file changes.

awayModeIndicator.preferNativeChatChip.description: Use the chat-input status item (OptionsLocation) when the running VS Code exposes it.

awayModeIndicator.showSessionScope.description: Show the focused workspace SESSION.md first lines in the tooltip.

awayModeIndicator.statusBarPriority.description: Order of the status-bar chip relative to other items (higher = further left). Use the Shift chip left/right commands for stepwise adjustment.

awayModeIndicator.sessionHeadLines.description: Number of SESSION.md head lines shown in the tooltip session scope.

enumDescriptions: GitHub Copilot Chat interactive question UI (chips above the Chat input)
Plain numbered question in chat prose
awayModeIndicator.arbitrationChannel.markdownDescription: Channel the agent MUST use for arbitrations. Binding via the agents memory rule, which reads this value from settings.json only - never from AGENTS.md content at run time.

awayModeIndicator.forceInteractiveArbitr.markdownDescription: ON: an autopilot auto-answer (class A, e.g. "user not available") never counts as an arbitration answer; the interactive UI reopens until a real answer. OFF: a class-A answer is accepted as a fall-back decision.
